texts: I am John Smith but people call me J.
Simple present tense with verb TO BE helps us to talk about personal information aspects about oneself and others. Look at the different examples in the chart.
Every personal pronoun has its own possessive adjective.
*It is the only aspect that uses a different verb.
native.joinedText:

FUNCTIONS
EXAMPLES
Express one’s and others’ names
My name is John
I am John Smith but people call me J.
State what people are
We are doctors
Talk about age
She is 32 years old
He is 20
State origins
They are from Argentina
It is American
State addresses
You live in New York *
Give contact information
My telephone number is 0162034550
Her email is sps_2015@mail.com
